desk:
**BLUF:** The OSINT/defence community in the last 48 hours has been quiet overall, with activity concentrated on Iranian internal incidents, Israeli domestic politics around foreign-influence probes, and a new Chinese PLAN amphibious ship. The single most important thread is @hey_itsmyturn’s real-time reporting of anti-aircraft fire and a major cellular outage inside Iran.

## MAIN THREADS
### Iran incidents
- [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2117697365805019443) reports a massive MCI cellular outage across most Iranian provinces at 22:15 local time, with gradual restoration.
- [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2117697470310318388) states AA fired several shots on the Andimeshk–Ahvaz road in Khuzestan Province minutes earlier.

### China naval developments
- [@TheStudyofWar](https://x.com/TheStudyofWar/status/2117699417868267983) assesses that the PLAN may soon commission the amphibious assault ship *Sichuan*, the only vessel of its type with an electromagnetic catapult, likely to boost carrier strike-group power beyond PRC waters.

### Israeli politics
- [@BarakRavid](https://x.com/BarakRavid/status/2117699323366695015) and [@BarakRavid](https://x.com/BarakRavid/status/2117698683567477184) report Shin Bet chief Zini seeking to investigate Arab-party politicians without supporting evidence in the foreign-influence probe and refusing to share materials with police.

## CONTESTED
Nothing contested.

## SINGLE-SOURCE CLAIMS
- [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2117697365805019443) — MCI outage affecting most Iranian provinces (unconfirmed).  
- [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2117697470310318388) — AA fire on Andimeshk–Ahvaz road, Khuzestan (unconfirmed).  
- [@TheStudyofWar](https://x.com/TheStudyofWar/status/2117699417868267983) — *Sichuan* commissioning would enhance PLAN carrier groups (unconfirmed).  
- [@BarakRavid](https://x.com/BarakRavid/status/2117699323366695015) — No evidence against three of four Arab politicians in Shin Bet probe (unconfirmed).

## WORTH WATCHING
Analysts will watch for follow-on Iranian unrest or further outages; any confirmation of *Sichuan* commissioning; and whether the Israeli Shin Bet probe escalates or is walked back.
